newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr slightly firmer vs yen but top-heavy in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Dlr slightly firmer vs yen but top-heavy in Tokyo.

text.p: 0522 GMT --*Dollar inches up against yen on light short-covering by interbank dealers in afternoon Tokyo but remains top-heavy amid exporter offers near 118.50 yen.
*Mark also edged up against yen, which indirectly supported greenback versus yen, a Japanese bank dealer said.
*Mark was quoted around 64.38/43 yen at 0522 GMT, compared with 64.29 yen at midday.
*Trading energy ebbed in Tokyo amid lack of trading incentives. Impact from key 182nd 10-year JGB yield's dip to record low also limited.
*Yield of key 182nd 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) briefly fell to 2.060 percent early on Tuesday afternoon. The bond yield closed at 2.085 percent on Monday.
*A dealer at a Japanese city bank said there was talk of stop-loss buying near 118.60 yen.

*Market participants are waiting for Bundesbank's announcement on money market rates and U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting later in day, but majority of traders expect no rate changes at either event.
*Dealers to closely watch moves in U.S. stocks and bonds later in New York trade.
